### v1.2.0 — Affective Response Engines + Async Processing

- Added 4 new composite affect engines: DARING, COURAGE, NURTURING, and MASTERY.
- Introduced async affective processing using ThreadPoolExecutor, enabling up to 50,000x speedup for cache hits.
- Implemented lazy VSA loading (optional with `NIMA_LAZY_LOAD=true`), reducing startup memory usage by ~173 MB.
- Added response modulator for dynamic, context-sensitive response generation.
- Introduced Voyage AI embedding support (optional, 1024D vectors).
- Added LRU cache for repeated affective queries (60s TTL), improving real-time performance.

## v1.1.9 — Hook Efficiency Fix

- Fixed excessive resource usage in nima-recall hook (was spawning new Python processes and loading large projection matrix each call)
- Introduced `recall_fast.py` CLI for direct SQLite access, bypassing model load
- Recall is now approximately 50–250x faster (down to ~50-100ms response)
- Prevents machine lockup when many recall hooks run concurrently
